3. **Wichita store (probably Marrow)**: you, 2 Jul 2025, 9:21 AM. You mentioned an 8am check-in with "the Wichita store dispatcher" right after Tobias said your Zoom was hosting the Marrow Agrisupply office hours. That message doesn't name the account, so check before you use it.

The 9 Jun messages also say three rows on the customer's rollout tracker only read "waiting," with no store names. Those stores never got named in the channel, so the list above may not be complete. Your notes from the store ops calls would be the place to fill in the rest.
